cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: destination · /ˌdɛstəˈneɪʃən/ · noun · Word · New
the place you are traveling to. Our destination is the library.
place · /pleɪs/ · noun · Word · New
a particular area or location. This place is the library.
toward · /tɔrd/ · preposition · Word · New
in the direction of someone or something. Walk toward the station.
go for a walk · /ɡoʊ fər ə wɔk/ · phrase · Phrase · New
To walk for enjoyment or gentle activity. Let’s go for a walk after lunch.
light · /laɪt/ · adjective · Meaning · New
Not heavy; easy to carry. This bag is light. I can carry it easily.

articulation.label: go
articulation.alt: go: /ɡ/ → /oʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

cards.title: Read and write
sections: Reading

Mia and Ben choose a place to meet. Their destination is the store by the park. Mia has a light bag and walks toward the store. Ben has a heavy bag and takes a bus. After they meet, they plan to go for a walk. A lamp gives them light near the entrance.
Find the answer
Why does Ben take a bus, and what will they do after meeting?
Write
Write two sentences using two words from today’s new word bank.
